title: Persona: Funkin All Night
subtitle: A Friday Night Funkin' Mod by The Funkin Thieves

SMB.description: Hey Thank You so much for playing! This mod has been something I've wanted to make since 2021 and finally seeing it be made and released means so much to me and I am very grateful for the team for helping make my dream fnf mod happen but also to you the player for downloading and playing this mod. I hope you enjoyed the Mod. For the stuff I did apart from directing and designing the mod I coded the Title Screen, Main Menu, Freeplay, Pause Menu and Results Screen. I also added some features to the mod. Once again Thank You so much for playing the Mod!

melodiekit.description:
Hiya!

I am one of the programmers for this mod!
I coded some of the UI like the Credits Menu, Options Menu, Music Player, and some other stuff.
I did the menu transitions in the main menu and pause menu. I liked how Persona has clean transitions in its UI so I wanted to at least try and do that a little bit.

I mainly recoded the backend of the engine for cool stuff, added some features like the Play as Opponent modifier, and ported the mod to android cause I'm a fat mobile chud.
I also charted Tartarus and Foggy Night.

Anyways, I hope you enjoyed the mod
and go listen to Flavor Foley. This is an advertisement for Flavor Foley listen to them NOW



Beware of &Baldiplier&...
